· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower 48,559, Middle 82,665 KRW): Approaching lower band, 82.52% band width suggests potential for increased volatility

· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): Close to SMA20 (82,665 KRW), breakout signals trend reversal

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Buy consideration possible due to RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement, but entry conditions require confirmation of SMA20 recovery
